diagnosis.summary: The 2026-10-01 nightly run failed because upstream sent an empty payments.csv. The file has the correct header but no data rows, so raw.payments loaded 0 rows (the usual level is about 439). The other failures follow from that: assert_payments_match_orders found 417 failing rows, fct_orders has no rows for the day, and the fct_orders tests were skipped. No dbt models changed, so I've proposed asking upstream to re-export payments for 2026-10-01 and then rerunning.

root_cause.explanation: The upstream payments export for 2026-10-01 was header-only (42 bytes, 0 data rows), and the header matches the contract. Ingest loaded raw.payments with 0 rows. That caused the payments-vs-orders test to fail and left fct_orders with no rows for the partition. Orders, order_items and customers arrived at normal volumes and no models changed, so this looks like a one-off delivery glitch.

evidence.claim: Upstream delivered a payments landing file with only a header (0 data rows), and the header matches the contract
Ingest loaded raw.payments with 0 rows, so the partition-present and trend checks fail
Downstream failures come from the missing payments: the payments/orders test fails and fct_orders is empty for the day
Other tables arrived at normal volumes
No dbt models changed from the deployed version
Runbook: a header-only file is an empty delivery, and the remedy for a one-off delivery glitch is redelivery

alternatives_considered: Bad dbt model deploy: ruled out because no models changed
Missing file: ruled out because the file exists but is empty
Transient failure / rerun_only: a rerun would reload the same empty file
Real business drop in payments: unlikely, because orders (440) are normal and payments should track orders
Escalate to upstream_app_team: only if the redelivered file is empty again

proposal.rationale: Upstream delivered a header-only payments.csv for 2026-10-01 (0 data rows, header matches contract), so raw.payments loaded 0 rows while orders/order_items/customers are normal. This is a one-off empty export; no dbt models changed. Downstream failures (assert_payments_match_orders, fct_orders empty/skipped tests) follow from missing payments. Redeliver payments for the day and rerun.
